title: launch P3 reviewed: why sigir ran slower, and the pathology report that moved

findings.claim: APPROVE costs about 41 s more per approval on 15108f46 than on 57263236 whatever the protocol (30 s to 71 s on one stream); with sigir's 3 streams it took 219 s per protocol and the budget cut 38 of 104
Which step of Compiler.approve costs the 41 s is in no record: no job records a step's time
Approvals of different rulesets appear to wait on each other in the compiler (2 or more in flight 78 % of P3's sigir seconds, each about 3 times its time alone)
On P3 the judge answered unknown on TCGA-EM-A3FK while its own reason is a plain fail, so the report moved from excluded (P2b) to open
P3's tcga read 939 of 1,020 note answers from the judged-pair store, so its 378 is not an independent measurement of the pair's run-to-run variation, and no figure says so
